n330e71bbbd.headline: The sale of the owner's shares has ended - Enlight became a company without a controlling stake
n330e71bbbd.summary: Eurocom and the Weil family sold 21% of Enlight's shares for 180 million shekels, leaving the company without a controlling stake.
n330e71bbbd.why: Changes in ownership structure can affect company governance and investor perceptions, influencing stock performance.
n330e71bbbd.why_moved: The sale of a large share block removed the controlling shareholder, impacting investor sentiment and stock price.

n28d043dfbd.headline: Largest bank in Australia loses data of 20 million accounts
n28d043dfbd.summary: Australia's largest bank reported losing magnetic tapes containing data of 20 million accounts, though it cannot confirm destruction of the information.
n28d043dfbd.why: Data loss at a major bank raises concerns about cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and customer trust in the financial sector.
